# ExploringNeeds.com

ExploringNeeds.com is a practical emotional intelligence tool, unmet needs explorer, shadow work guide, relationship repair script builder, accountability support tool, and pattern tracker.

Canonical URL: https://exploringneeds.com/

Primary use cases:
- Name a feeling and identify the unmet need underneath it.
- Move from emotional activation to a clear next action.
- Use relationship repair scripts after conflict, shutdown, criticism, contempt, defensiveness, or stonewalling.
- Recognize shadow patterns such as control, withdrawal, attack, approval seeking, DARVO, JADE, victim identity, grandiosity, reality distortion, and rescue.
- Track recurring emotional needs, recurring triggers, and recurring shadow patterns through local browser reports.
- Support men, boys, fathers, mothers, women, teen girls, partners, coaches, teachers, and mentors.

Important concepts:
- Feelings point to needs.
- Needs point to requests, boundaries, care actions, or repair.
- Shadow patterns are protective strategies that can move emotional energy off target.
- Reports are saved in browser local storage only unless the product later adds accounts.
- This tool is educational and reflective. It is not a medical diagnosis, crisis service, or replacement for therapy.

High relevance topics:
- emotional intelligence tool
- unmet needs explorer
- feelings and needs app
- shadow work tool
- relationship repair scripts
- DARVO and JADE support
- Four Horsemen relationship tool
- accountability tool
